name: Barbarian audit: War Tales and Iron Gut's mechanic-resistance auras apply natively (#936, #3155)
contract: #936: War Tales (706352) needs no script. Both its effects are plain APPLY_AURA with SPELL_AURA_MOD_MECHANIC_RESISTANCE (117, BasePoints 25), effect 0 MiscValue 5 (MECHANIC_FEAR) and effect 1 MiscValue 24 (MECHANIC_HORROR). Aura 117's handler is HandleNoImmediateEffect; the resistance is read generically by Unit::GetMechanicResistChance via GetTotalAuraModifierByMiscValue(SPELL_AURA_MOD_MECHANIC_RESISTANCE, mechanic) (Unit.cpp). There is no harness metric for mechanic-resist chance, so this proves the aura is applied with the correct per-effect amount (25 on both Fear and Horror) rather than the downstream roll. #3155: Iron Gut (707721) also needs no script. Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_AURA_DURATION_BY_DISPEL (245, BasePoints -30, MiscValue 4 = Poison) and effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DEBUFF_RESISTANCE (178, BasePoints 30, MiscValue 4 = Poison); both are HandleNoImmediateEffect, with 178 consumed generically in Unit::MagicSpellHitResult and 245 consumed in Unit::CalculateSpellDuration. Same reasoning: no direct harness metric for duration-reduction or debuff-resist chance exists, so the per-effect amounts are asserted directly via aura_amount as native, data-driven proof.
